Getting Ready for Your Kambo Ceremony: A Friendly Guide

By Kaira Otero, LCSW
Co-founder, Sacred Origins NYC

Welcome to Sacred Origins! If you’re considering a Kambo ceremony, you’re about to embark on a unique journey of healing and transformation. Kambo, the sacred medicine from the Amazonian giant monkey frog, has been cherished for centuries for its purifying and revitalizing effects. Here’s a cozy, friendly guide to help you prepare your mind, body, and spirit.

Preparing with care, intention, and gentle mindfulness

1. Nourishing Your Body

Watch Your Diet:

  • A Few Days Ahead: Shift toward clean, whole foods. Emphasize fresh vegetables, fruit, wholesome grains, and light proteins. It’s an ideal time to minimize caffeine, alcohol, processed sugars, and heavy oils.
  • The Day Before: Eat light meals for breakfast and lunch. For dinner, enjoy a simple vegetable broth or herbal tea. This gently prepares your digestive system for the cleansing process.
  • Fast Before Ceremony: On the morning of your ceremony, come on a fasting stomach (no solid food for 8 to 10 hours prior).

Hydration Guidelines:

Drink plenty of water in the days leading up to your session. However, do not force-drink massive quantities of water on your own beforehand—water intake during ceremony must always be guided step-by-step by your certified practitioner to maintain safe electrolyte balance.

2. Preparing Your Mind & Heart

Set Clear Intentions: Spend quiet time journaling about what you are seeking to release and what qualities you wish to cultivate—whether that is mental clarity, physical vitality, emotional freedom, or renewed direction.

Embrace Grounding: Practice gentle stretching, nature walks, or meditation in the days preceding the circle. Approaching the medicine from a calm, centered state allows you to surrender with trust.

3. Communicating with Your Practitioner

Honest communication is the cornerstone of safe ceremonial care. Always inform your practitioner of your full medical history, prescription medications, supplements, or past conditions. At Sacred Origins, every participant completes a thorough health intake to ensure absolute safety.

4. Post-Ceremony Integration

Plan a slow, restful schedule for the rest of the day following your session. Nourish yourself with warm soup, rest in cozy clothing, and give yourself space to absorb the energetic lightness and mental clarity that Kambo leaves in its wake.

Written by Kaira Otero, LCSW

Co-founder of Sacred Origins NYC, Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW), Reiki Level II practitioner, and certified Kambo practitioner.
